model: Siemens LMV3 burner management via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Siemens LMV3 (LMV26/36/37) burner management systems with Modbus, read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the Siemens LMV3: 246 objects (221 AI, 13 AO, 11 BI, 1 BO), 26 polled by default. Polled objects give burner control phase, fuel and air actuator positions, VSD output, fuel type, output, flame signal, throughput, the current error and the input/output states; BO 14 switches the controller on/off. Remote-mode, preselected output and counter registers are unpolled outputs.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Siemens_Combustion_Control_LMV3_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the LMV3 Modbus documentation (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/LMV3.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 26 of the 246 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.

integration.summary: Use Controller on/off (BO 14) for enable; for BMS modulation, enable and set Modbus mode, the remote operating mode and the preselected output. Read phase, output, flame signal and the current error.
integration.enable: Controller on/off (BO 14) is polled by default. Remote output control needs Modbus mode (AO 27), the remote operating mode (AO 29) and the preselected output (AO 30), all unpolled in the published profile.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Modbus breakdown time (AO 28) and the output preselected for a communication breakdown (AO 40) set what the LMV does if Modbus stops; check them before using remote mode.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
